text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Hishi Akebono's debut race had 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That's Hishi Akebono?! Standing next to 
the other girls, she really is huge~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm looking forward to the race 
too! It's gonna be so intense~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many in the crowd surrounding the paddock 
were completely captivated by Hishi 
Akebono's massive size!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, everyone's really looking forward 
to it, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to do my best! After all, 
this is the first step toward a "chanko 
nabe" feast.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Hishi Akebono took a deep breath. 
Then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hello~! I'm Hishi Akebono! An 180cm, big 
Umamusume~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
In today's debut race, I'm going to clash 
head-on with everyone and give it 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So make sure you build up an appetite and 
wait for me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst lively applause, Hishi Akebono's 
debut race got underway!
